name: Child Support Caseload and Collections
description:
This dataset contains child support enforcement records organized by indicator, case type, and date. Each row pairs a measure, such as total cases with orders, support establishment percentage, cases with collections, current distributions, or calendar year collections, with a case category (total, current, former, never, or yearly goal) and a reporting date. Numeric fields capture caseload counts, percentage rates, and dollar amounts, though many rows leave one or more of these blank depending on the measure reported.

The data can be used to track caseload trends over time, compare collection performance across case types, and assess program outcomes such as the share of cases with established orders or active collections. Analysts, researchers, and agency staff could use it to monitor progress toward yearly goals, evaluate the effectiveness of enforcement efforts, and support budgeting or policy decisions related to family support services.
